supports: Location: 6990 Dickman Rd., Apollo Beach, FL 33572

In the winter months the manatees leave colder waters to return to this warm and welcoming refuge
Tampa Electric proudly offers free parking and admission to all who visit
Visitors can wander along boardwalks overlooking the warm-water area where manatees gather
